sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by fluorescent anti-Myc antibody fluorescence microscopy on transfected cells (β17 isoform); no functional assay specifically for PCDHB6 reported.
sites.rationale: The ledger (L1) explicitly names the stalk between EC6 and the TM helix as the insertion site for a Myc epitope tag in β-Pcdh isoforms closely related to PCDHB6 (β17 cited). For PCDHB6 this stalk corresponds to the extracellular span immediately proximal to the TM helix (residues ~660–687, with TM beginning at 688). No specific residue junction is given in the paper, so insert_after_residue is left null and the region is recorded. The evidence is indirect (β17 ortholog, same subfamily) and region-level only, warranting low confidence. PMC12157453 reports Myc-tagged clustered β-Pcdh constructs (including β17, a close paralog of PCDHB6) with the tag placed in the stalk region between EC6 and the TM helix, described as equivalent to previously validated constructs; surface expression was confirmed by fluorescent anti-Myc antibody staining on transfected cells (L2).

sources.claim: For derived constructs including the myc tag, the tag was positioned in the stalk region between EC6 and the transmembrane helix ( Figure S1A ), equivalently to previously validated constructs ( 21 ).

literature_notes: Only two ledger lines are available (L1, L2), both from the same paper (PMC12157453) and both describing the same Myc-tag insertion in the stalk region of β-Pcdh isoforms (specifically β17, a close paralog of PCDHB6). No specific residue number is named in either clip, so the site is reported at region level with insert_after_residue null. No N-terminal tag evidence exists in the ledger; L1 explicitly localises the tag to the stalk, not the mature N-terminus. No intracellular or function-abrogating positions are named in the ledger, so other_positions is empty. The extracellular span of PCDHB6 runs from residue 28 to 687 (TM: 688–709); the stalk (EC6-TM linker) occupies approximately residues 660–687.
